## 🚀 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 💡 Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed?

**Example**: As a [user type], I want to [action] so that [benefit].

## 🎯 Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working. Be as detailed as possible.

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions

Have you considered any alternative approaches? Describe them here.

## 🌍 African Market Relevance

How does this feature address specific needs in the African market?

- [ ] Supports low-bandwidth environments
- [ ] Mobile-first design consideration
- [ ] Addresses local regulatory requirements
- [ ] Supports local payment methods (Mobile Money, etc.)
- [ ] Multi-language support needed
- [ ] Works offline or with intermittent connectivity
- [ ] Other: ___________

## 👥 Target Users

Who will benefit from this feature?

- [ ] SACCO Managers
- [ ] Loan Officers
- [ ] Treasurers/Auditors
- [ ] SACCO Members/Clients
- [ ] System Administrators
- [ ] Other: ___________

## 📊 Priority

How important is this feature to you?

- [ ] Critical - Blocking current operations
- [ ] High - Significantly improves user experience
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Future consideration

## 🛠️ Technical Considerations (Optional)

If you have technical knowledge, describe any implementation considerations:

- Database changes needed
- API endpoints required
- Third-party integrations
- Performance implications
- Security considerations

## 📸 Mockups/Examples (Optional)

If you have mockups, wireframes, or examples from other applications, please share them here.

## 📝 Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or information about the feature request here.

## 📎 Related Issues

Link any related issues or features here.
